summary: Independent max-tier review of task 012 (4 fresh read-only claude-opus-5-5 xhigh dispatches; codex skipped for quota). Corrected both high findings (review tasks could not complete through the runner; revise generation check was opt-in) plus medium/low findings: explicit pre-generation upgrade, guarded writer-lock takeover with PID-reuse detection, on-disk scoped-input binding, flag-digest carry-forward, study_gate preservation, runner-authoritative receipt validations, receipt check before side effects, generation restore on write failure. Final dispatch 4 approved with no critical/high finding; remaining medium/low findings are recorded as limitations and follow-ups.

acceptance_coverage.case: A failed revision leaves the previous manifest and task projections readable.
Every requirement has a consumer; every implementation has explicit acceptance and validation.
A transformed research task remains pending with subtasks instructing implementation from its report.
Legacy schema 1-3 files are not silently rewritten using schema-4 projection rules.

limitations: D4-F01 (medium): complete/reset write or delete learning/design files before the stale-generation check in save_manifest; only stale writers reach it.
D4-F02 (medium): a dependent completed after an out-of-band (hand-edited) dependency change is not reopened by revise; hand-editing manifest.json is unsupported.
Tier/effort reclassifications are rebuilt from the spec on revise; planners must restate them (D2-N01 partial).
The live .ai-work plan is not migrated to generation counters; run recover-projections once while no runner is active (D2-N06).
Crash tests use process-level interruption (os._exit) and injected exceptions, not power-loss or fsync fault injection.
Bytes-read and rebuild-duration measurements asked for by the prepared decision were not taken; no cost/latency claim is made.

Remaining low findings (narrow double-fault guard races, unmarked pre-013 flag digests, CLI complete without runner validation evidence, studyctl direct manifest writes, requirement-ID preservation not enforced, digest excludes requirement text) are recorded in 013-outcome.md.

findings.title: Tasks with requires_independent_review can never complete through the runner
A stale plan revision can replace a newer generation by default (generation check is opt-in)
Pre-012 schema-4 manifests never get a generation, so the live plan has no stale-writer check or lag detection
Writer lock: stale-takeover race, live locks can be stolen, Windows edge cases
Scoped-input binding only restates the plan's declared hashes and never hashes the real files
Scoped digests passed with --scoped-input-digests are not carried into later revisions, so unrelated completed tasks get reopened
Negative tests never reach the staged-audit rollback; some checks pass vacuously
complete/reset wrappers make two separate locked saves
Saves with bump_generation=False reuse a generation; lag detection checks only the generation number
Leftover create-staging directories are not cleaned; MODEL_MATRIX is not rebuilt on revise
Gaps in the dependency and research-output checks
revise rebuilds the manifest from the spec and silently drops study_gate and audited tier/effort reclassifications
Completion builds the receipt from the stored contract_digest but validates it against a recomputed one, so out-of-band contract edits block completion
A failed worker-reported validation now blocks completion even after the runner's own validation passed
Writer-lock takeover loop skips the deadline and the sleep: it busy-spins, and hangs if the stale lock cannot be removed
Digest carry-forward is not limited to flag-bound digests, so removing a binding from the spec is silently ignored
The live plan is still unmigrated; a minor doc mismatch
N02 rewrites stored digests for all tasks, so a later revise re-binds a stale receipt
Completion side effects run before the receipt check and persist if it fails
A failed write leaves the in-memory generation ahead of disk
Narrow lock races remain in guard removal and in lock release
Older flag-bound digests are silently unbound
A CLI `complete` receipt has no validation evidence and ignores failed checks
studyctl writes the manifest without the lock or a generation bump
The 012 receipt's file hashes no longer match the corrected files
Generation check runs after complete_task/reset_task have already changed files
Dependent task completed after an out-of-band dependency edit is not reopened by revise
A completion rejected during subtask reconciliation still changes subtask state
revise silently moves an in_progress task back to pending when its contract changes
Renaming a task ID with task_id_mapping makes revise fail when that task has a preserved learning artifact
Requirement IDs are not preserved across revisions
Contract digest leaves out requirement text and implementation guidance
revise creates a receipt for tasks completed before 012 using unverified declared input hashes
The 012 receipt and log no longer match the reviewed code
